posts.title: Poem Reading for the Season of Spirits
posts.description: HAPPY HALLOWEEN, POETS! Do you like listening to poems being read? I do, but I don’t always have the leisure to go to in-person poetry readings, though there are many around the SF Bay Area. I often go to Youtube to find poem readings, and then I decided to start doing my own. Society of Ghost Poets – excerpt This night before All-Souls Day, centuries of poets rise in living lines chanted by youtu

posts.description: The Invisibles is my series of novels about the Greene family and their discovery of .what it means to be family — stories that embrace, sibling connection, love, romance, sacrifice, and adventures with the beyond.
